display_long_description:
Finally — a VR video player built the way it should have been all along.

Point it at your own collection and press play. Finally indexes local files and streams straight from your network drives (SMB) — no uploads, no accounts, no subscriptions.

**Plays everything, properly.**
- Hardware-accelerated playback up to 8K
- VR180, VR360, fisheye, flat, SBS/TB — auto-detected, with overrides that stick
- Blu-ray ISO support for your decrypted rips
- Photos and stills in the same library

**Built for the headset.**
- Native OpenXR theater with SIMPLE and PRO cockpit modes
- Grab the library and flick it — momentum scrolling for big collections
- True scene dolly, refresh-rate matching, lie-back tilt follow
- One-controller friendly: everything reachable from one hand

**Mixed reality, done right.**
- Alpha-packed AR video plays in your real room, not a black void
- Four simultaneous chroma keys with an in-headset laser color picker
- Passthrough lobby — or drop in your own 360° worlds

**Your library, your rules.**
- Local storage and SMB shares as first-class sources
- Resume positions, per-title memory, A-B loops, live color controls
- No telemetry, no analytics, no ads

Full field manual at finallyvr.com. If you have a media collection and a Quest, this is the player you've been waiting for.
